name: RunPod
billingNote: Stopped pods retain billable storage. GPU availability and Secure Cloud prices come from the provider; CPU catalog prices may require its console.

name: Vast.ai
billingNote: Marketplace offers include a specific host and GPU count. Stopped instances retain storage charges; bandwidth can cost extra.

name: Crusoe Cloud
billingNote: VM type, location, and image must be compatible. Disk, reserved capacity, and network charges can continue after stopping.

name: Nebius AI Cloud
billingNote: Uses a project, platform, preset, subnet, and image. Pricing depends on region and billing agreement; unquoted presets remain visible.

name: Prime Intellect
billingNote: Pods support termination, not reversible stop/start. Export your data before deleting a pod. Quotes include the full GPU configuration.

name: JarvisLabs
billingNote: Pause stops compute billing while retaining storage. Prices use your account currency; region stock and CPU/RAM combinations are listed separately.

name: Thunder Compute
billingNote: Instances support deletion, not reversible stop/start. Included CPU and disk depend on the GPU configuration; extra CPU and disk add charges.

name: Latitude.sh
setupCommand: wsl --exec bash -lc 'export PATH="$HOME/.lsh:$PATH"; lsh help authentication'
billingNote: Powering off bare metal does not end allocation charges. Delete the server to release it. Prices and stock are location specific.

name: Civo
billingNote: Stopped instances are still billed. Delete to end instance charges. Existing SSH keys and a restricted firewall are required.

name: E2E Cloud
billingNote: Uses the CLI's selected alias and a project and location. Power-off billing depends on the plan; confirm it in your account.
